title: PostgreSQL Boolean Logic: COALESCE and NULLIF
realWorldScenario: An invoice PDF generator displays "null" or blanks when a customer does not have a registered billing contact name.
questionStatement: Explain how the `COALESCE` function works in SQL. Provide an example showing how to replace NULL values with a default fallback string.
hints: COALESCE takes multiple arguments and stops at the first non-null.
